$description: Generated from Figma by scripts/figma/export-components.js (run once in each library file). The agent's API for the DKB libraries: every component names its `file` (components = DKB Components, Core; commerce = DKB Commerce). Import a component set with figma.importComponentSetByKeyAsync(key) (or an icon with importComponentByKeyAsync), pick a variant by its variant properties, then set properties with instance.setProperties({ [properties.<name>.id]: value }). Do not edit by hand.
